description: Tool to list EventCreateRules configured on a web data stream. Use when you need to retrieve event create rules for a specific GA4 property data stream.

inputSchema.description: Request model for listing EventCreateRules on a web data stream.

pageSize.description: Optional. Maximum number of event create rules to return. Default is 50, maximum allowed is 200.
pageSize.title: Page Size

pageToken.description: Optional. A page token received from a previous list call. Provide this to retrieve the next page of results.
pageToken.title: Page Token

parent.description: Required. Resource name of the parent data stream. Format: properties/{propertyId}/dataStreams/{dataStreamId}.
parent.title: Parent

name: list_event_create_rules

destinationEvent.description: The name of the new event to be created. Must be under 40 characters, contain only letters, digits, or underscores, and start with a letter.
destinationEvent.title: Destination Event

eventConditions.description: Required. Array of matching conditions (minimum 1, maximum 10) that must be satisfied on the source event for the rule to activate.
eventConditions.title: Event Conditions

name.description: Output only. Resource name of this event create rule. Format: properties/{property}/dataStreams/{dataStream}/eventCreateRules/{eventCreateRule}.
name.title: Name

parameterMutations.description: Parameter mutations are applied to the event after the event is created. A maximum of 20 mutations can be applied.
parameterMutations.title: Parameter Mutations

comparisonType.description: The type of comparison to be applied to the value.

field.title: Field

negated.title: Negated

value.description: The value that is compared against.

MatchingCondition.title: MatchingCondition

parameter.title: Parameter

parameterValue.description: The value to set the parameter to.
parameterValue.title: Parameter Value

ParameterMutation.title: ParameterMutation

eventCreateRules.description: List of EventCreateRule resources. The order is arbitrary.
eventCreateRules.title: Event Create Rules

nextPageToken.title: Next Page Token
